layout: 100 unique posts; zero append or return-position displacement; no horizontal overflow on either viewport.
limits: One cold/warm sample per view and viewport; navigation values are not percentile claims.
Cold means fresh browser context plus cleared/disabled HTTP cache; OS cache and retained SQLite remain warm. Warm means same context repeat; production no-store asset headers remain active.
Usable time is first correct result DOM followed by two animation frames, a rendering opportunity proxy, not display-device paint instrumentation.
Input timing is trusted input event to two animation frames, not hardware keyboard latency.
Synthetic cursor adapter and SQLite responses do not qualify authenticated chain/RPC budgets or archive rebuild.
Search is explicit form submission in the current product, not a 150 ms automatic debounce. Warm search uses a second query against the warm process/index, not a cached repeated query.
No chain, proof, wallet, rebuild or shared service actions. This qualifies the scoped synthetic browser measurements, not all RC40 conditions.
procedureCorrections: Full-document navigation now passes through about:blank to avoid same-document cached timing; initial aborted values discarded.
Search observer corrected to production main .feed h2 selector; completed desktop navigation/scroll/return measurements retained.
